info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Investment Portfolio Allocations-v5-spec
info.description: The Investment Portfolio Allocations API enables users to efficiently access detailed information about their investment portfolio allocations. By utilizing this endpoint, financial analysts and investors can retrieve a comprehensive list of allocation percentages across various asset classes within their portfolios. This data is vital for portfolio management, performance analysis, and strategic decision-making. Typical consumers of this API include investment firms, portfolio managers, and individual investors seeking to optimize their investment strategies.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch comprehensive details about the allocation of assets within the portfolio. It provides insights into the distribution of investments and helps in understanding the portfolio's performance and risk profile.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving all allocations of the portfolio. This should contain the necessary parameters to filter or specify the allocations being requested.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the portfolio allocation data.
